Bug_Title: NP: Method call passes null for non-null parameter (NP_NULL_PARAM_DEREF)
Bug_Details:
This method call passes a null value for a non-null method parameter.
Either the parameter is annotated as a parameter that should
always be non-null, or analysis has shown that it will always be
dereferenced.
Bug_Explanation: The method printLength expects a non-null String as a parameter, but in the showBug method, null is passed as an argument.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case testShowBug calls the method showBug which then calls the method printLength with null as a parameter. This triggers the bug as printLength expects a non-null String parameter.
